entities.summary: First Battle of Tarain, also known as the First Battle of Taraori, was fought on 14 January 1191 between the Ghurid forces led by Muhammad of Ghor and the Rajput Confederacy led by Prithviraj Chauhan, near Tarain. The battle ended in a victory for the Rajputs; however, Muhammad of Ghor managed to escape and returned to Ghazni.
